k: Godlike people of the realm of Asgard
st: From the golden realm of Asgard, Odin's people defeat the Frost Giants and keep the peace across the Nine Realms.
Malekith's Dark Elves attack Asgard, and Queen Frigga is killed protecting Jane Foster.
Hela kills Asgard's army, Surtur destroys the realm, and Thor leads the survivors away on the Statesman.
Thanos attacks the refugee ship, kills Loki and Heimdall among many others, and destroys the Statesman.
The survivors live in New Asgard, a fishing village in Norway, and Thor makes Valkyrie their king.
Gorr attacks New Asgard and takes its children, who fight their way home with Thor's power and train as warriors.
Beaten by Odin and stripped of their Casket, they lose King Laufey to his son Loki, who nearly destroys Jotunheim.

k: A huge horned beast of Jotunheim's ice
st: A giant Frost Beast attacks Thor's party on Jotunheim, and Thor kills it by smashing right through it.
One follows the Convergence battle through a portal to London and is left running loose on Earth.
Gravik's rebel Skrulls hold Frost Beast DNA among the samples they use to make Super-Skrulls.

k: Ancient beings of the darkness before light
st: Eons ago Bor defeats the Dark Elves on Svartalfheim, but Malekith and a few warriors escape into a long sleep.
Woken by the Aether, they attack Asgard, but Malekith and his last warriors are destroyed in the Convergence.
A captive Dark Elf stands among the Collector's living exhibits on Knowhere.
Runa, a shape-shifting Light Elf from New Asgard, loses a fraud case for posing as Megan Thee Stallion.

k: Fiery beings of Muspelheim, ruled by Surtur
st: Thor beats Surtur in Muspelheim, but Loki revives him and the fire demon destroys Asgard in Ragnarok.

k: Master smiths of the star forge Nidavellir
st: Thanos kills the dwarves of Nidavellir after they forge his gauntlet, sparing only King Eitri, who forges Stormbreaker.
On Vanaheim, a giant rock warrior fights for the marauders until Thor shatters it with one blow of Mjolnir.
Korg, a gentle rock gladiator on Sakaar, leads the slaves' revolt and leaves with Thor's Asgardians.
Korg lives in New Asgard, playing video games with Thor and Miek.
Korg says Kronans make children by two males holding hands over lava, and after Zeus shatters him he finds love with Dwayne.

k: A warrior empire ruled by an AI
A dying empire on a barren Hala
st: In 1995 the Kree of Hala, ruled by the Supreme Intelligence, wage war on the Skrulls until Carol Danvers turns on them.
The Kree sign a peace treaty with Xandar, but the fanatic Ronan rejects it and tries to destroy the planet.
Civil war since Carol destroyed the Supreme Intelligence has left Hala barren, until Carol reignites its sun.
Refugee Skrulls hide on Earth from the Kree, and Carol Danvers leaves with them to find a new home.
A Skrull posing as an FBI agent tells Monica Rambeau that a friend of her mother wants to meet her.
Talos and Soren pose as Nick Fury and Maria Hill on Earth while the real Fury works aboard a Skrull ship.
A million Skrulls hide on Earth; Gravik's rebels kill Talos, and a new US law brands all aliens as enemies.
Dar-Benn tears the air from Tarnax, the Skrull colony Carol helped found, and its refugees must flee.

k: Looks like a cat, swallows things whole
st: Goose, a Flerken passing as a cat, swallows the Tesseract and Kree soldiers, then stays with Nick Fury.
Goose has a litter of Flerken kittens on S.A.B.E.R., and Fury uses them to swallow and save the station's crew.

k: People of Xandar, home of the Nova Corps
st: Ronan tries to wipe out Xandar, but the Nova Corps and the Guardians save the planet.
Thor says Thanos decimated Xandar to take the Power Stone.
Thanos's army raids Gamora's homeworld and kills half its people at random, and Thanos takes young Gamora.
Nebula, a blue Luphomoid raised by Thanos, says he replaced her body with machine parts each time she lost to Gamora.

k: Thanos's people, from the planet Titan
st: On ruined Titan, Thanos says his people died out after rejecting his plan to kill half of them at random.
Thor kills Thanos, and his 2014 self later turns to dust when Tony Stark snaps.
Eros, a royal prince of Titan and brother of Thanos, appears and joins the Eternals Thena, Makkari and Druig.
Sakaaran soldiers fight for Ronan and fall by the hundreds in his attack on Xandar.

k: Space gods who plant new Celestials in planets
st: Knowhere is a dead Celestial's severed head, and the Collector shows one leveling a planet with the Power Stone.
Ego, a Celestial who built a planet around himself, tries to take over every world until the Guardians kill him.
Arishem plants Celestial seeds in planets, but the Eternals turn Tiamut to stone before he can emerge from Earth.
Tiamut's stone body, now Celestial Island, yields adamantium and sparks a race between nations to mine it.

k: Immortal beings made by the Celestial Arishem
st: In 5000 BC the Celestial Arishem sends ten Eternals to Earth to protect humans from the Deviants.
Learning they exist to let Tiamut be born, they rebel and stop him, and Arishem takes three away for judgment.

k: Monsters made by the Celestials to hunt predators
st: Made to cull predators, the Deviants turn on humans, and the Eternals hunt them across Earth.
Thought wiped out in 1521, they return in the present, and Thena kills their evolved leader Kro.

k: Golden people made by the High Evolutionary
st: High Priestess Ayesha's Sovereign hunt the Guardians over stolen batteries, then create Adam to destroy them.
Their creator, the High Evolutionary, threatens to wipe them out, and Ayesha dies on Counter-Earth.
An Abilisk attacks the Sovereign's Anulax batteries, and the Guardians kill it.
The High Evolutionary keeps three Abilisks on Arête; Mantis befriends them and leaves to travel with them.
Watchers listen to a chatty old informant in a spacesuit, then walk off in the middle of his stories.
A Watcher narrates as Baby Groot loses a sacred seed in a collapsing temple.

k: Tree-like beings who say only "I am Groot"
st: Groot gives his life to shield his friends on Xandar, and a cutting from him sprouts into a new baby Groot.
Baby Groot helps free Rocket and Yondu, plants the bomb on Ego's brain, and later grows into a sulky teenager.
Groot gives his arm as the handle of Stormbreaker, then turns to dust in Thanos's snap.
Restored five years later, Groot arrives with the Guardians to fight Thanos's army.
Grown tall, Groot helps save Rocket's life and the High Evolutionary's captives, and stays on Knowhere as a Guardian.

k: Animals uplifted by the High Evolutionary
st: Testing on young Rocket and Batch 89, the High Evolutionary makes Humanimals to people his ideal Counter-Earth.
Finding Counter-Earth imperfect, he bombards the whole planet and kills its Humanimals.

k: Cyborg animal guards of the High Evolutionary
st: War Pig and the High Evolutionary's other Hellspawn attack the Guardians and Knowhere, and are beaten.
Lent to Loki, the Chitauri invade New York and drop dead when Iron Man destroys their mothership.
A captive Chitauri soldier stands among the Collector's living exhibits on Knowhere.
Chitauri troops serve as Thanos's soldiers, and a flashback shows them raiding Gamora's homeworld.
Thanos brings his 2014 Chitauri to the present, and Tony Stark's snap turns them all to dust.

k: Giant armored beasts that carry Chitauri
st: Giant armored Leviathans carry Chitauri troops through the portal and smash through New York.
The remains of a Leviathan lie in Baron Strucker's HYDRA lab in Sokovia.
Leviathans from 2014 join Thanos's attack on the Avengers and turn to dust with his army.

k: Feral six-limbed beasts of Thanos's army
st: Thanos's Outriders throw themselves against Wakanda's shield by the thousands, and many die in the battle.
Outriders from 2014 swarm the ruined Avengers Compound and turn to dust when Tony Stark snaps.
In the 1500s, a Maya people struck by smallpox and Spanish conquest drink a vibranium herb and become water-breathers.
Hidden for centuries in Talokan, they go to war with Wakanda over vibranium, then Namor makes peace with Shuri.

k: Exiles who claim to be djinn
st: Exiled from the Noor dimension, they kill Aisha in 1947 and later try to break the Veil home, until Najma dies closing it.

k: Ancient gods who act through human avatars
st: The gods trap Khonshu in a stone ushabti, and Harrow frees Ammit until Marc and Layla seal her inside him.

k: A man who turns into a wolf beast
st: Monster hunter Jack Russell is secretly a werewolf; forced to change by the Bloodstone, he escapes Bloodstone Manor.

k: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Sealed behind Ta Lo's Dark Gate, they break out when Wenwu attacks it, until their master the Dweller is slain.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
st: Morris, a hundun, escapes the Ten Rings with Trevor Slattery and guides Shang-Chi's group to Ta Lo.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

k: A living alien liquid that bonds to a host
st: Pulled into this universe with Eddie Brock, the symbiote is sent home but leaves a small piece behind in a bar.
Mole Man's people of Subterranea shelter New York's evacuees underground when Galactus comes.

k: Peoples of the subatomic Quantum Realm
st: Conquered by Kang, the Quantum Realm's natives hide out as rebels under Jentorra's lead.
Cassie frees Jentorra, and the natives rise up and help overthrow Kang.

k: Tiny blue beings living under a rock
st: Baby Groot finds the tiny Grunds under a rock and feeds them a leaf, then accidentally steps on them.

k: Singing people of the water world Aladna
st: On Aladna, where people speak in song, Dar-Benn opens a jump point and drains water from their world.
